changelog: Fixed Seerr permissions being ignored. Seerr permissions are now checked before exposing *arr profiles. Users only with Request submit with Seerr defaults. Advanced requests/Manage requests get the profile picker. If no permission, requests will be denied. Letterboxd follows the same rule.
description: The best way to discover and request Movies and TV Shows through Seerr directly in Jellyfin.
name: SeerrFin
overview: This plugin lets you add two extra tabs to your top bar, allowing you to discover new Movies and TV Shows, and easily request them in any quality profile you want.
